none: PAS KENT-4AE126: Roman. Coin. Nummus or AE4 of House of Constantine. Reverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, contemporary copy of a nummus or AE4 of the House of Constantine. Obverse: Helmeted bust of Roma left. Inscription: VRBS ROM[A]. Reverse: She wolf left suckling the twins Romulus & Remus - for Old Rome. Inscription: None. Mint mark: -//... Minted in Britain by provenance. Reece period 17. Die axis: 6 o'clock. The coin is in fine conditon with some wear and most of the edges have broken away. The coin has a dark green patina with some surface pitting. This coin is likely to date to 330-340AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2011, page 62 no. 600 and Identifying Roman Coins, Richard Reece & Simon James, Seaby 1986 reprint 1994,…
